notes.title: 1.1 Update! QOL improvements and new item!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm pleased to announce a new update! I added the cloud in a bottle upgrade, which increases your jump height:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262607/d9b532c053b3c54ee6a8602221c39792553b1c40.png

I also improved the controller experience in the shop, made it so you can see the current level and loop numbers from the pause menu, and I added a button in the pause menu which allows you to see all your upgrades and stats at any time:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262607/be162b1036eeba7b305139b5dfcf9f4e21e9dc70.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262607/e0022c1dc62112419bf35bf99eddcda625f41c04.png

Thank you to everyone who has played the game!

-Vincent Poteet
